label: Assertion retorsion controls for the five separate bridges
description: Independent assignments give an asserted denial without belief even when F6 holds and the same denial has a reason, a speech marker without cognitive meaning, an assertion marker without thought, a thought realizing an assertion and represented as existing without phenomenal experience, and an occurring thought in a model with an empty existence extension. These interpretations isolate bridges and do not establish that any assignment is metaphysically possible.
